item.title: Alaska officials stonewall state legislators on justification for handing voter data to feds
item.description: The Alaska Division of Elections and Department of Law declined to waive confidentiality on advice that led the state to hand detailed data to the U.S. Department of Justice.

item.title: Taku Winds spring concert, ‘Touchstones of Glaciers and Bears’ library presentation, and Mudrooms storytelling event season finale
item.description: Juneau Afternoon featuring previews of the "Rhapsody in Blue" concert from Taku Winds, Library presentation with authors Naomi Klouda and Marybeth Holleman, and Mudrooms storytelling event featuring the theme Rut-Roh (Dog-gone it).

item.title: Juneau Assembly to vote on Dzantik’i Heeni playground funds, St. Vincent’s maintenance
item.description: Juneau residents have the chance to testify on ordinances on Monday in person or online before the Assembly votes.

item.title: In Haines, a small army of locals is gearing up to host a global ski competition
item.description: The Freeride World Tour draws the globe's best backcountry skiers and snowboarders, who pick their way down ungroomed, world class slopes.

item.title: The snow is back: 2026 Iditarod kicks off with Anchorage ceremonial start
item.description: Snow continued to fall Saturday as 37 Iditarod Trail Sled Dog Race teams mushed through Alaska's largest city.

item.title: Trump administration plans to end ban on bear baiting in Alaska national preserves
item.description: The proposal would reestablish state authority to manage sport hunting and trapping in federal territory that is part of the national park system.

item.title: Juneau singer-songwriter Taylor Dallas Vidic’s first album delves into relationships through jazz-folk mashup
item.description: Juneau musician Taylor Dallas Vidic has joined a lot of acts in and outside of Juneau over the years. Now, after working on it for years, she’s releasing her first album, Cat and Mouse, in April.

item.title: Juneau School Board to discuss proposed budgets, union contract for support staff
item.description: The district reached a tentative agreement with Juneau Education Support Staff, or JESS, last week. If approved, the agreement will increase costs for the district.
